expected_return_setup: Extreme upside remains possible if direct-to-device broadband scales globally, but revenue is still pre-scale relative to market capitalization.
next_review_trigger: next BlueBird launch or material MNO economics update
notes: Small staged position only; do not allocate the full first deposit to ASTS at an uncapped price.

expected_return_setup: Credo has strong AI interconnect growth and margin quality, but the current valuation requires durable hyperscaler demand and clean customer diversification.
next_review_trigger: next quarterly result or customer concentration disclosure
notes: High-quality candidate, but not a full-deposit buy at current valuation.

expected_return_setup: Astera remains a strong AI rack-scale connectivity platform candidate, but price-to-sales near 66 leaves little margin for execution or demand mistakes.
next_review_trigger: next quarterly result or design-win update
notes: Watch for a better entry or evidence that growth durability is stronger than the market already assumes.

expected_return_setup: Vertiv has real AI power and cooling evidence, but its size makes extreme satellite-account compounding harder from this base.
next_review_trigger: next order/backlog/liquid-cooling update
notes: Eligible for comparison, but not the highest-upside use of the first USD 888.

expected_return_setup: Nebius could benefit from scarce AI cloud capacity, but debt, utilization economics, customer concentration, valuation, and MagicByte/Eigen AI Labs integration make the entry setup unresolved.
next_review_trigger: next 6-K or customer/financing/integration update
notes: Keep on watchlist; MagicByte/Eigen AI Labs is strategically relevant but does not solve financing, utilization, or customer economics.

expected_return_setup: Micron has direct HBM and AI memory exposure, but trillion-dollar scale and memory cyclicality reduce asymmetric upside from current prices.
next_review_trigger: next earnings or HBM supply/margin update
notes: Watch for a thesis-preserving downcycle or margin reset.

expected_return_setup: CoreWeave is direct AI cloud capacity exposure, but heavy debt and customer concentration can overwhelm equity if utilization or financing conditions weaken.
next_review_trigger: next earnings/customer concentration/debt update
notes: Do not buy without deeper leverage and customer-contract review.

expected_return_setup: Circle could become regulated programmable-money infrastructure, but current valuation depends on durable USDC economics beyond rate-sensitive reserve income and the token purchase agreements need clearer shareholder-economics review.
next_review_trigger: next reserve/USDC/token-economics/earnings update
notes: Companyfacts enterprise value is distorted by reserve-like balances; token purchase agreements block promotion until economics are clearer.

expected_return_setup: Cerebras has AI systems optionality, but a recent IPO and incomplete public metrics make valuation and execution durability hard to underwrite.
next_review_trigger: after at least two public quarterly reports
notes: Wait for public quarterly evidence before considering a buy.

next_review_trigger: next AI cloud deployment/customer revenue/financing update
notes: Dell agreement strengthened the execution path, but convertible financing and capex commitments keep IREN off the current buy list.

expected_return_setup: Oklo has advanced nuclear optionality, but commercial proof, licensing, fuel access, deployment timing, and the USD 1.0 billion ATM dilution overhang remain unresolved.
next_review_trigger: next NRC/licensing/customer deployment or ATM usage update
notes: Do not buy before a material licensing or deployment evidence change and clearer dilution discipline.

expected_return_setup: Bloom has AI power-scarcity relevance, but current price-to-sales near 41 and debt/service obligations make entry unattractive.
next_review_trigger: next customer/order/cash-flow update
notes: Wait for lower valuation or cleaner cash conversion evidence.

expected_return_setup: Centrus has distinct HALEU scarcity exposure at a less extreme valuation, but government policy and enrichment scale-up control the thesis.
next_review_trigger: next DOE/HALEU/capacity update
notes: Possible future candidate after deeper DOE and contract review.

expected_return_setup: Globalstar adds spectrum-backed direct-to-device optionality, but Apple/partner concentration, capex, and network economics remain unresolved.
next_review_trigger: next Apple/direct-to-device/capex update
notes: Useful ASTS peer, not yet buyable.

expected_return_setup: Kratos has defense autonomy and space communications exposure, but contractor economics may cap the asymmetry.
next_review_trigger: next unmanned systems/space communications/backlog update
notes: Monitor, but lower priority than RKLB or ASTS for first allocation.

next_review_trigger: next commercial revenue/system delivery or SkyWater transaction update
notes: Keep optionality on watchlist; wait for commercial proof, transaction clarity, or dislocation.

expected_return_setup: Intuitive Machines has space infrastructure upside, but mission execution, acquisition integration, debt, and cash burn keep entry uncertain.
next_review_trigger: next mission/contract/acquisition integration update
notes: Potential staged candidate only after fresh mission or contract evidence.

next_review_trigger: next quarterly report, offering update, lockup or selling-holder update, or major price dislocation
notes: Research-only dashboard candidate; not a current buy or watchlist promotion.

next_review_trigger: next quarterly report or customer/datacom/HPC concentration update
notes: Research-only optical manufacturing peer; do not buy without evidence of durable pricing power or a thesis-preserving dislocation.

next_review_trigger: next quarterly report, NVIDIA partnership update, CPO or optical circuit switching design-win update, customer concentration disclosure, debt exchange update, Greensboro capacity update, or price dislocation
notes: Watchlist optical photonics peer; do not buy without a thesis-preserving price dislocation or clearer proof of durable CPO/OCS pricing power.
